pages.en: “…Maybe it was simply Zouken's confidence. Was he so arrogant he thought he could kill me whenever he pleased?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “…I guess he was playing around. Maybe he thought he could kill me any time.”

「……そうね、他に理由があったんでしょうけど、衛宮くんを生かしていたのは臓硯の余裕だったのかも。
そう考えると付け込む隙にはなりそうだけど……」

pages.en:
“…Maybe. I'm sure he had some other reason, but perhaps Zouken kept you alive because he felt he had everything under control.

“If so, that very confidence may leave us an opening…”

“…Yeah. I’m sure there’s some other reason, but maybe he could afford to keep you alive as long as he wanted.
Maybe we could take advantage of that opening…”
